caption: The drawing features a single object that appears to be a metal tool or artifact, shown on a plain, off-white background. The object consists of two main parts: a horizontally oriented bar at the top with a hook at each end, and a vertical rod or arm that is attached to the horizontal bar slightly off-center via a circular joint. The horizontal bar is decorated with diagonal lines creating a series of geometric triangular patterns along its surface. Both the horizontal bar and the vertical rod are brown, suggesting a rusted or aged metal appearance. The vertical rod has a slightly bulged section near the top and a rectangular loop or slot near its bottom. The drawing’s shading and coloration give the object a three-dimensional and metallic look, with variations in brown tones to suggest light and texture. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Latch from Mission
